items.detail: Wrexham have signed Sunderland goalkeeper Anthony Patterson in a deal that sources told ESPN could eventually break the club's transfer record.

items.headline: Chelsea complete signing of Pep Chavarría
items.detail: Chelsea have completed the signing of Pep Chavarría from Rayo Vallecano, with the left-back becoming the ninth new addition to the first-team at Stamford Bridge.

items.headline: Liverpool fans seek clarity over Bezos-linked bid
items.detail: Supporters' group Spirit of Shankly (SoS) has written to Liverpool to stress the ownership and control of the club is "fundamental to us all."
